long_description: This project is a port of [GensokyoClub's Th06 Decomplilation](https://github.com/GensokyoClub/th06) to the 3ds using the Citro3d graphics library.
preinstall_message: You will need to provide your own copy of Touhou 6 (v1.02h) and place it in sd:/th06/ (See github for more detailed instructions)
